validation.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.

expired.title: Link expired
expired.lead: Sign-in links expire after 15 minutes for security. Request a new one — we'll send it to the same email.
expired.why: Email links expire after 15 minutes. If you waited longer or refreshed the link, it's no longer valid.

invalid.title: Link not recognised
invalid.lead: This sign-in link doesn't match any pending request. Request a fresh one to continue.
invalid.why: The link was malformed or already used. Each link works exactly once, from the browser that requested it.

rateLimited.title: Too many attempts
rateLimited.lead: We paused new links for a few minutes to keep your account safe. Try again shortly.
rateLimited.why: Several links were requested in quick succession. This cooldown protects you from sign-in abuse.

forgot.title:
Locked out?
Let's get you back in.
forgot.body: Enter the email tied to your Partner workspace. We'll send a single-use reset link to that inbox.
forgot.note: Reset link expires in 30 minutes · Same-browser session required

resetSent.title:
Reset link on the way.
Check your inbox.
resetSent.body: Open the link from the same browser session — it expires in 30 minutes. After reset, you'll sign back in with your new password.
resetSent.note: Didn't arrive? Check spam — most reset emails land in <2 min.
